Are you accurate, reliable, and interested in the logistics behind medical products? Join the UPS Healthcare team in Roermond, where you’ll help ship life-saving medicines and medical equipment to destinations all over the world. Are you enthusiastic, motivated, and ready to become part of our team? Then we’d love to hear from you! What’s your job about? As a Warehouse Employee in Herkenbosch, you play a vital role in the logistics process within the healthcare sector. You are responsible for processing orders, managing inventory, and ensuring accurate handling in both cooled and frozen storage areas. You’ll work in a dynamic environment where precision and speed are essential. Your daily tasks include: Receiving & storing goods Order processing Inventory management Preparing shipments Maintaining cleanliness and order in the workplace You can work in dayshift or 2 shifts, which means you’re responsible for ensuring smooth operations during this period. This requires a flexible mindset and a proactive attitude. You’ll be part of a team that values collaboration, so you can always count on the support of your colleagues. What skills do you have? In this role, you work in the foil cutting department within a cleanroom setting. You are responsible for accurate processing of sensitive materials used in high tech packaging. Are you ready to help make the tastiest vlaaien in the Netherlands? Every day in Panningen, the most delicious vlaaien are baked that you will find in almost every major supermarket. What will you bring? - Experience in the food sector as an operator; - Willing to work 3-shifts as well; - Knowledge of HACCP; - Speaking the Dutch, English or German language; - Flexibility from Monday to Sunday; - Strong team player and willing to attend training courses.

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!

Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 

What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks are:

- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile and punctuality – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to € 18,19 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery – delivery bag, helmet and phone holder
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040. 

Be part of a movement that’s changing the way the world eats.

What do we ask?
To start as a delivery courier with Uber Eats, you must meet the following conditions:

•            You are at least 16 years old

•            You live in the Netherlands

•            You speak either Dutch or English
